original.statement: The Docker provider's `tls.caOptional` configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.

of.needed: whether the Traefik static configuration file (YAML/TOML) sets providers.docker.tls.caOptional

corrected.statement: Traefik v3 removes the Docker provider static option providers.docker.tls.caOptional. An environment is exposed if it sets this option, either with the CLI flag --providers.docker.tls.caOptional or in a YAML/TOML static configuration file.

decision.reason: [ev-dac3a3c51ce8] shows three ways to set the removed option: a YAML file, a TOML file, and the CLI flag --providers.docker.tls.caOptional. An exposure condition that checks only the CLI flag misses environments that set the option in a static configuration file, so it is too narrow. The proposed overlap, "the flag is not set", is not a shielded state: it would tell every other environment it is safe, including ones that set the option in a file. The corrected exposure keeps the CLI-flag check and adds an undecidable operand for file-based static configuration; there is no overlap.
